Hi Alicia / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap: we covered use cases, data residency constraints, and a rough throughput target. The team asked for a short technical handoff with our SEs to validate integration path (KV cache / batching assumptions) and scope the POC.

We had the deep-dive on the calendar for this week but saw a conflict/no-show on your side. To keep momentum, can you confirm one of these short windows (both PT):
- Fri 2026-07-02 10:00–10:30 PT
- Fri 2026-07-02 16:00–16:30 PT

If you can confirm within 24 hours we’ll lock the slot and include Ben (SE). If we don’t hear back we’ll release those windows and re-open them for other pilot customers — we don’t want to overbook.

Attached: deep-dive agenda (PDF) and a one-page mutual action plan (XLSX). I’ve summarized the key asks in the agenda and marked the items we’ll need from your infra/ops team.

Next steps I propose:
1) You pick one of the two slots above (or propose two short alternatives).
2) Confirm if 20 or 30 minutes is preferred — we can compress to 20m for a focused handoff.
3) Ben (cc’d) will run the tech portion and own follow-ups.

Thanks — appreciate a quick yes/no so we can reserve the time.

Best,
Marissa
